cards.front_en: How does the IIA define internal auditing?
cards.back: 조직의 운영을 개선하고 가치를 부가하기 위해 설계된 독립적·객관적 보증 및 컨설팅 활동. 체계적이고 훈련된 접근방법으로 위험관리·통제·거버넌스 프로세스의 효과성을 평가·개선하여 조직의 목표 달성을 돕는다.
cards.back_en: Internal auditing is an independent, objective assurance and consulting activity designed to add value and improve an organization's operations. It helps an organization accomplish its objectives by bringing a systematic, disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of risk management, control, and governance processes.

cards.front_en: What is the difference between Independence and Objectivity in internal auditing?
cards.back: 독립성은 조직(부서/기능) 차원의 속성 — 감사기능이 편향 없이 책무를 수행할 수 있는 보고체계와 위상. 객관성은 개인(감사인) 차원의 속성 — 공정한 정신적 태도, 이해상충 회피.
cards.back_en: Independence is an organizational/functional attribute — the freedom from conditions that threaten the ability of the internal audit activity to carry out responsibilities in an unbiased manner. Objectivity is an individual mental attitude — an unbiased mindset that avoids conflicts of interest.

cards.front: 최고감사책임자(CAE)의 보고체계로서 독립성을 보장하는 가장 적절한 구조는?
cards.front_en: What CAE reporting structure best ensures independence?
cards.back: 기능적(functional)으로는 이사회/감사위원회에 보고하고, 행정적(administrative)으로는 CEO에게 보고하는 이중 보고체계. CAE 임면·보수에 대한 이사회의 승인이 권고됨.
cards.back_en: A dual reporting structure: functionally to the board / audit committee, and administratively to the CEO. The board should approve the appointment, removal, and compensation of the CAE.

cards.front: IIA의 'International Professional Practices Framework(IPPF)' 핵심 요소는?
cards.front_en: What are the components of IIA's International Professional Practices Framework (IPPF)?
cards.back: Mission, 의무 가이드(Core Principles, Definition, Code of Ethics, Standards), 권고 가이드(Implementation Guidance, Supplemental Guidance).
cards.back_en: Mission of Internal Audit; Mandatory Guidance (Core Principles, Definition of Internal Auditing, Code of Ethics, Standards); and Recommended Guidance (Implementation Guidance, Supplemental Guidance).

cards.front_en: What are the 4 principles of the IIA Code of Ethics?

cards.front: 위험관리 3선 모델(Three Lines Model, 2020 개정판)에서 각 선의 역할은?
cards.front_en: What is the role of each line in the IIA Three Lines Model (2020 revision)?
cards.back: 1선: 운영 관리(위험을 직접 보유·관리). 2선: 위험·컴플라이언스 기능(전문성 제공·모니터링). 3선: 내부감사(독립적 보증). 거버닝 바디는 책무, 경영진은 행동.
cards.back_en: First Line: operational management (owns and manages risk). Second Line: risk, compliance and other support functions (provides expertise and monitoring). Third Line: internal audit (independent assurance). The governing body has accountability; management takes action.

cards.front_en: What is the difference between Inherent Risk and Residual Risk?
cards.back: 고유위험: 통제가 적용되기 전의 위험 수준. 잔여위험: 경영진의 통제 적용 후 남는 위험 수준. 감사인은 잔여위험이 위험 수용도(risk appetite) 내에 있는지 평가.
cards.back_en: Inherent risk is the risk level before any controls are applied. Residual risk is the risk that remains after management has applied controls. The auditor evaluates whether residual risk is within the organization's risk appetite.

cards.front_en: What are the 5 components of the COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework?
cards.back: 통제환경(Control Environment), 위험평가(Risk Assessment), 통제활동(Control Activities), 정보 및 의사소통(Information & Communication), 모니터링 활동(Monitoring Activities).
cards.back_en: Control Environment, Risk Assessment, Control Activities, Information & Communication, and Monitoring Activities.

cards.front_en: Examples of Preventive vs. Detective controls?
cards.back: 예방통제: 오류·부정 발생 자체를 막음 (예: 직무분리, 접근권한 제한, 승인 절차). 발견통제: 발생한 사건을 사후 식별 (예: 정기 대사, 예외 보고서, 내부감사).
cards.back_en: Preventive controls stop errors/fraud from occurring (e.g., segregation of duties, access restrictions, authorization procedures). Detective controls identify events after they have occurred (e.g., periodic reconciliations, exception reports, internal audits).

cards.front_en: Difference between Assurance and Consulting engagements?
cards.back: 보증: 3자 관계(감사인-피감사자-이용자), 감사인이 독립적 평가를 제공. 컨설팅: 2자 관계(감사인-고객), 자문·조언 성격, 약속 범위가 고객과 합의.
cards.back_en: Assurance: a three-party relationship (auditor – auditee – user); auditor provides an independent assessment. Consulting: a two-party relationship (auditor – client); advisory in nature; scope agreed with the client.

cards.front: 내부감사인이 과거 1년 이내에 운영했던 부서를 즉시 감사할 수 있는가?
cards.front_en: May an internal auditor immediately audit an area they operated within the past year?
cards.back: 원칙적으로 불가. IIA Standard 1130.A1에 따라 자신이 책임졌던 활동에 대한 보증 약속은 객관성이 손상된 것으로 간주 — 통상 12개월 이상 경과해야 함.
cards.back_en: No. Per IIA Standard 1130.A1, internal auditors must refrain from assessing operations for which they were previously responsible. Objectivity is presumed to be impaired for at least one year following the prior assignment.

cards.front: 'Due Professional Care(적절한 직업적 주의)'가 요구하는 것은?
cards.back: 합리적으로 신중한 감사인이 같은 상황에서 발휘할 기술과 주의. 절대적 보증이 아닌 합리적 보증을 의미. 약속 범위, 복잡성, 비용·편익을 고려해야 함.
cards.back_en: The care and skill expected of a reasonably prudent and competent internal auditor in the same circumstances. It implies reasonable, not absolute, assurance. Auditors must consider the engagement's scope, complexity, and cost vs. benefit.

cards.front: IIA가 요구하는 품질보증 및 개선 프로그램(QAIP)의 외부평가 주기는?
cards.front_en: How often must the QAIP external assessment occur per IIA Standards?
cards.back: 최소 5년에 1회 이상 외부 평가(External Assessment) 필수. 자기평가 + 독립적 검증 또는 완전한 외부 평가 형태 가능.
cards.back_en: External assessments must be conducted at least once every five years. They may take the form of either a full external assessment or a self-assessment with independent external validation.

cards.front_en: What are the 3 elements of the Fraud Triangle?
cards.back: Pressure(압박/동기), Opportunity(기회), Rationalization(합리화). 내부감사인은 통제 설계 시 특히 '기회'를 줄이는 데 초점.
cards.back_en: Pressure (incentive/motive), Opportunity, and Rationalization. Internal auditors focus on reducing Opportunity through control design, since pressure and rationalization are largely individual factors.

cards.front: 내부감사가 조직 거버넌스에 기여하는 핵심 방식은?
cards.front_en: How does internal audit contribute to organizational governance?
cards.back: 윤리·가치 증진, 효과적 성과관리·책무성 확보, 위험·통제 정보의 적절한 부서 간 전달, 거버닝 바디·경영진·내·외부감사인 간 활동 조율 평가.
cards.back_en: By assessing and making recommendations to: promote appropriate ethics and values; ensure effective performance management and accountability; communicate risk and control information to appropriate areas; and coordinate activities among the board, management, and internal/external auditors.
